snippet.title: Who's at the Door? | Launch Trailer | Steam PC
snippet.description:
Coming to PC (Steam) on July 18, 2025
Step into a chilling psychological horror experience from Skonec Entertainment 🇰🇷. Trapped in a small apartment with no memory and signs of psychosis, you must:

🔍 Observe your surroundings carefully
🧠 Distinguish reality from terrifying hallucinations
💊 Take mysterious medication handed to you by strange visitors

Can you uncover the truth... before the door opens again?
Add to your wishlist now on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690010/Whos_at_the_door/

#Horror #WalkingSimulator #Games
